text: The major is designed to train professionals with basic knowledge in electronic technology and information system, basic theory and techniques of information collection, processing and transmission, and basic practice in electronics and information engineering. It turns out senior engineering and technical personnel who are capable of information processing systems, communications systems and electronic equipment research, design, application development and operation analysis. Electronic information is a broad-range field. Great attention has been paid to cultivate personnel with technology in comprehensive IT manufacture, public network and private network, focused on electronic information technology applications.
